children: Shore Bancshares reported third-quarter 2026 net income of $16.8 million, or $0.50 per diluted share, and shared its investor presentation.
Net interest margin rose to 3.78% from 3.70% in Q2, while net interest income increased 4.2% to $55.1 million.
Deposits grew 5.5% sequentially to $5.70 billion, partly reflecting seasonal municipal deposits; core deposits increased $10.2 million.
Loans edged up 0.5% to $4.90 billion; the allowance for credit losses was $59.6 million, or 1.21% of loans.
For 2026, the company’s outlook includes low- to mid-single-digit loan growth, mid-single-digit deposit growth and a 3.60%–3.75% net interest margin.
The investor presentation is furnished for potential investor and analyst meetings; the company said it does not undertake to update its information.
